detail.body: # [PD] Send prefill KV chunks as soon as the batch result copy completes ## Motivation With the overlap scheduler, a prefill batch's KV transfer is only started when its result is processed in `process_batch_result_disagg_prefill`, which runs after the *next* batch has been launched. In addition, `send_kv_chunk` runs on the schedule stream behind the WAR barrier of the next forward. As a result the KV transfer of batch N starts roughly one full batch duration after batch N finished on the GPU. On a prefill-saturated 1P1D setup we measured a median delay of 0.08-4.4 s between "batch GPU done" and "KV transfer enqueued". This delay scales with batch duration and adds directly to TTFT. ## Modifications Adds an opt-in path, `SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_KV=1` (default off), in which a dedicated worker thread (`EarlyKVChunkSender`) sends a batch's KV chunks as soon as the batch's `copy_done` event completes. The worker uses its own CUDA stream, so it does not wait for the next forward. - **Per-request ownership** (`KVSendOwner`: `NONE` / `EARLY` / `SCHEDULER`, stored on `Req`). - Ownership is fixed when the request's first batch result is submitted. An eligible request is owned by the worker for its whole lifetime: all middle chunks, the last chunk, and appending the first token. - All other requests stay on the existing scheduler path, and the scheduler skips sends for `EARLY` requests. - Each request's KV is therefore always sent by exactly one sender, in order. - A request is eligible when it has a bootstrap room, has finished bootstrapping, has no output yet, and does not need logprobs, a sampling mask, or grammar. Those features need the scheduler-side result processing before the last chunk. - **Delayed sampling** (grammar / `SGLANG_ENABLE_DELAY_SAMPLE`): `copy_done` is only recorded after `launch_batch_sample_if_needed`, so submission happens after that call in that case. - **KV lifetime and aborts.** - Paths that release an `EARLY` request's KV hold `EarlyKVChunkSender.lock` via `early_kv_send_lock(req)`, so the worker never reads freed KV pages. These paths are `_retire_aborted_prefill_result`, `handle_inflight_transfer_failure`, and `process_pending_chunked_abort`. - The worker skips requests that were aborted or whose KV was already released. - When an `EARLY` request is aborted after the worker may have started sending, the scheduler aborts its sender (`KVPoll.Failed`) and lets it drain through the inflight queue instead of retiring it directly. - A failed middle-chunk send aborts the sender and skips the request's remaining chunks. - **`handle_inflight_transfer_failure`** now keeps an existing `FINISH_ABORT` reason instead of always overwriting it with `FINISH_LENGTH(0)`. Without this, a client abort that surfaces as a transfer failure is reported as a normal length finish. **Behavior change:** this also applies with the flag off. - **Lifecycle:** the worker is stopped in `teardown_disaggregation` (PD role switch). `optimistic_release_and_requeue` resets ownership. - **Support matrix.** When enabled with an unsupported configuration, the flag is ignored with a warning and the scheduler path is used. - Requires: CUDA, the overlap scheduler, and the Mooncake backend. - Not supported with: staging buffer, KV checksum, speculative decoding, the `prefill_complete` decode allocation policy, unified memory, or models that transfer extra state (`state_types`, e.g. Mamba / SWA / DSA). - **Cached-prefix early send** (`maybe_send_cached_prefix_chunk`) is skipped for `EARLY` requests. - **Docs:** the new variable is added to the Mooncake prefill configuration table in `pd_disaggregation.mdx`. - **Tests:** - New unit tests in `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_early_send.py`: support matrix, ownership, submit, worker send / abort / failure handling. - New e2e test `test/registered/disaggregation/test_disaggregation_early_send_kv.py`: GSM8K accuracy, greedy consistency between sequential and concurrent requests, and mixed logprob / regex requests. The prefill server runs with `--enable-deterministic-inference` so the consistency check is not affected by batch-dependent numerics (without it, concurrent vs sequential first tokens also differ with the flag OFF). - Existing test fakes (`test_prefill_abort_result_cleanup.py`, `test_auxiliary_output.py`) get the new `kv_send_owner` field. ## Accuracy Tests 1P1D, TP4 each, Mooncake RDMA, same server code with the flag OFF vs ON. GSM8K, `few_shot_gsm8k`, 500 questions, 5-shot: | | Accuracy | Invalid | |---|---|---| | OFF | 0.898 | 0.000 | | ON | 0.908 | 0.000 | Output consistency, from an earlier prototype of this change (same copy-done trigger): - **Greedy, sequential (30 prompts):** 30/30 identical outputs between ON and OFF. - **Concurrent (200 prompts):** ON vs OFF differs in about 33% of outputs. This matches the OFF-vs-OFF control (69/200 differ) and the ON-vs-ON control (70/200 differ), so the differences come from batch-dependent numerics, not from the change. - **Regex and logprob requests (which stay on the scheduler path):** regex 20/20 full match and logprobs 20/20 present in both modes. ## Speed Tests and Profiling **Setup.** - 1P1D, TP4 each (H20), Mooncake RDMA, `--page-size 16`, radix cache on, chunked prefill off. - Workload: `bench_serving --dataset-name generated-shared-prefix`, 200 prompts, input 1024 / output 100. "Prefix" is the shared system-prompt fraction of the input. - Each cell is the mean of 2 runs with identical seeds in both modes, and the cache is flushed before every run. - All 24 runs completed 200/200 requests with no errors. With ON, every request was sent by the early sender. | prefix | QPS | TTFT mean OFF → ON (ms) | Δ | TTFT p99 Δ | E2E mean Δ | ITL p99 Δ | throughput Δ | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 60% | 10 | 7480 → 3731 | -50.1% | -43.6% | -42.2% | -25.2% | +3.9% | | 60% | 20 | 15207 → 10213 | -32.8% | -19.0% | -30.5% | -26.1% | +3.7% | | 70% | 10 | 2722 → 1323 | -51.4% | -52.1% | -24.9% | -5.6% | +0.8% | | 70% | 20 | 10529 → 6543 | -37.9% | -27.2% | -35.8% | -42.8% | +6.9% | | 80% | 10 | 312 → 240 | -23.0% | -30.8% | -4.2% | -8.7% | +0.1% | | 80% | 20 | 4422 → 2189 | -50.5% | -44.6% | -35.3% | -39.0% | +8.7% | Client-side mean TPOT goes up in some cells (up to +52% at 70% / QPS 10) but down in others (-23% at 70% / QPS 20). This is a measurement artifact: with OFF, tokens produced while the first token is delayed arrive in a burst right after it, which lowers the client TPOT average. ITL p99 is lower with ON in every cell. **Where the time goes.** These numbers come from local-only timestamp instrumentation, which is not part of this PR. The metric is the time from a prefill batch finishing on the GPU to the last KV chunk's send being enqueued. Median: 1267 ms with OFF vs 3.2 ms with ON. p99: 4440 ms vs 42 ms. The breakdown of mean TTFT shows that with OFF, this wait (red) is 0.07-3.45 s per request, and ON removes it: Prefill batches on the GPU, with the moment each request's KV send is enqueued (70% prefix, QPS 10): - **OFF:** a batch's KV is only sent after the *next* batch has finished on the GPU. - **ON:** the send starts as soon as the batch finishes. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #38229627983](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38229627983) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #38229627536](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38229627536) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #38229627936](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38229627936)

+"""Early send of prefill KV chunks.
+
+Enabled by ``SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_KV``.
+
+Under overlap scheduling the result of prefill batch N is processed only after
+batch N+1 has been launched, and the page-index reads in ``send_kv_chunk`` run
+on the schedule stream, which the WAR barrier fences behind N+1's forward. Every
+KV chunk computed by N, including the last one that decode waits on, is
+therefore handed to the transfer engine roughly one forward late.
+
+``EarlyKVChunkSender`` sends the chunks of N from a worker thread as soon as N's
+result copy (``copy_done``) completes, reading page indices on its own stream.
+
+Each request's KV is sent by exactly one side, fixed at its first launched
+batch (``Req.kv_send_owner``):
+
+- ``EARLY``: the worker sends every chunk, in launch order, and appends the
+  first output token with the last one. The scheduler sends nothing for it.
+- ``SCHEDULER``: requests whose last chunk depends on the processed result
+  (logprobs, grammar, sampling mask) or on a pending bootstrap keep the
+  original path.
+
+Paths that release an ``EARLY`` request's KV before its transfer concludes
+hold ``lock`` so no worker send is reading it; the worker skips requests that
+are aborted or no longer hold KV.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import queue
+import threading
+import weakref
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, List, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import KVSendOwner, TransferBackend, is_aborted
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_disagg
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req, ScheduleBatch
+    from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import GenerationBatchResult, Scheduler
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _ChunkSend:
+    batch_index: int
+    req: Req
+    # KV computed through this batch; snapshotted at launch since the next
+    # chunk's scheduling moves req.extend_end.
+    end_idx: int
+    is_last: bool
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _BatchSend:
+    copy_done: torch.cuda.Event
+    next_token_ids: torch.Tensor
+    chunks: List[_ChunkSend]
+
+
+class EarlyKVChunkSender:
+    def __init__(self, scheduler: Scheduler):
+        self._scheduler = scheduler
+        self.lock = threading.Lock()
+        # None stops the worker.
+        self._queue: queue.SimpleQueue[Optional[_BatchSend]] = queue.SimpleQueue()
+        # Worker-thread only: requests whose earlier chunk failed to send.
+        self._failed_reqs: weakref.WeakSet[Req] = weakref.WeakSet()
+        self._device = torch.cuda.current_device()
+        # Must not be the schedule stream: the WAR barrier makes it wait for the
+        # next batch's forward, which is the delay this class removes.
+        self._stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=self._device)
+        threading.Thread(
+            target=self._worker,
+            name="prefill-early-kv-chunk-send",
+            daemon=True,
+        ).start()
+        logger.info("Prefill early KV chunk send enabled")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def maybe_create(cls, scheduler: Scheduler) -> Optional[EarlyKVChunkSender]:
+        if not envs.SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_KV.get():
+            return None
+        if not cls.is_supported(scheduler):
+            logger.warning(
+                "SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_KV is not supported with this "
+                "configuration; KV chunks are sent by the scheduler"
+            )
+            return None
+        return cls(scheduler)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def is_supported(scheduler: Scheduler) -> bool:
+        return (
+            torch.cuda.is_available()
+            and scheduler.enable_overlap
+            and not scheduler.enable_staging
+            and scheduler.kv_checksum_computer is None
+            and scheduler.spec_algorithm.is_none()
+            and get_disagg().disaggregation_decode_allocation_policy
+            != "prefill_complete"
+            # Sends run off the scheduler thread; only Mooncake is verified.
+            and scheduler.transfer_backend == TransferBackend.MOONCAKE
+            # Compaction may move pages while the worker reads their ids.
+            and not scheduler.enable_unified_memory
+            # Extra state payloads (mamba, SWA, DSA, ...) are unverified.
+            and not scheduler.disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue.kv_manager.kv_args.state_types
+        )
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self._queue.put(None)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def is_eligible(req: Req) -> bool:
+        return (
+            req.bootstrap_room is not None
+            and not req.pending_bootstrap
+            and len(req.output_ids) == 0
+            and not req.return_logprob
+            and not req.return_sampling_mask
+            and req.grammar is None
+        )
+
+    def submit(self, batch: ScheduleBatch, result: GenerationBatchResult) -> None:
+        """Queue a launched batch; call once its result copy has been recorded.
+
+        Fixes the KV send owner of requests seen for the first time.
+        """
+        can_send = result.copy_done is not None and isinstance(
+            result.next_token_ids, torch.Tensor
+        )
+        chunks = []
+        for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):
+            if req.kv_send_owner == KVSendOwner.NONE:
+                req.kv_send_owner = (
+                    KVSendOwner.EARLY
+                    if can_send and self.is_eligible(req)
+                    else KVSendOwner.SCHEDULER
+                )
+            if req.kv_send_owner != KVSendOwner.EARLY:
+                continue
+            input_len = len(req.origin_input_ids)
+            chunks.append(
+                _ChunkSend(
+                    batch_index=i,
+                    req=req,
+                    end_idx=min(req.extend_end, input_len),
+                    is_last=req.extend_end >= input_len,
+                )
+            )
+        if chunks:
+            assert can_send, "EARLY-owned request in a batch without a result copy"
+            self._queue.put(_BatchSend(result.copy_done, result.next_token_ids, chunks))
+
+    def _worker(self) -> None:
+        torch.cuda.set_device(self._device)
+        while True:
+            batch_send = self._queue.get()
+            if batch_send is None:
+                return
+            try:
+                with torch.cuda.stream(self._stream):
+                    self._send_batch(batch_send)
+            except Exception:
+                logger.exception("Early KV chunk send failed")
+
+    def _send_batch(self, batch_send: _BatchSend) -> None:
+        batch_send.copy_done.synchronize()
+        token_ids = None
+        for chunk in batch_send.chunks:
+            if chunk.is_last and token_ids is None:
+                token_ids = batch_send.next_token_ids.tolist()
+            with self.lock:
+                self._send_chunk(
+                    chunk, token_ids[chunk.batch_index] if chunk.is_last else None
+                )
+
+    def _send_chunk(self, chunk: _ChunkSend, token_id: int | None) -> None:
+        req = chunk.req
+        if req in self._failed_reqs or is_aborted(req) or not req.kv.holds_kv:
+            # The scheduler concludes it through the inflight queue or abort.
+            return
+        try:
+            if chunk.is_last:
+                req.output_ids.append(token_id)
+                self._scheduler.send_kv_chunk(req, last_chunk=True)
+                req.time_stats.set_prefill_transfer_queue_entry_time()
+            else:
+                self._scheduler.send_kv_chunk(
+                    req, last_chunk=False, end_idx=chunk.end_idx
+                )
+        except Exception:
+            # A missing range cannot be resent safely; fail the transfer so the
+            # scheduler concludes the request through the inflight queue.
+            logger.exception("Early KV chunk send failed for %s", req.rid)
+            if not chunk.is_last:
+                self._failed_reqs.add(req)
+            req.disagg_kv_sender.abort()

@@ -238,6 +238,10 @@ def teardown_disaggregation(scheduler: Scheduler) -> None:
                 km.teardown()
             scheduler.disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue = None
         scheduler.disagg_prefill_inflight_queue = []
+        sender = getattr(scheduler, "early_kv_chunk_sender", None)
+        if sender is not None:
+            sender.stop()
+            scheduler.early_kv_chunk_sender = None
     elif mode == DisaggregationMode.DECODE:

+import re
+import unittest

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.disaggregation_fixture import (
+    PDDisaggregationServerBase,
+)
+from sglang.test.sgl_eval_utils import run_sgl_eval
+from sglang.test.test_utils import DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=400, stage="base-b", runner_config="2-gpu-large")
+
+
+class TestDisaggregationEarlySendKV(PDDisaggregationServerBase):
+    extra_prefill_env = {"SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_KV": "1"}
+    # Batch-invariant prefill so concurrent and sequential first tokens must match.
+    extra_prefill_args = ["--enable-deterministic-inference"]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        cls.model = DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST
+        cls.launch_all()
+
+    def test_gsm8k(self):
+        args = SimpleNamespace(
+            base_url=f"http://{self.base_host}:{self.lb_port}",
+            eval_name="gsm8k",
+            max_tokens=512,
+            num_examples=200,
+            num_threads=128,
+        )
+        metrics = run_sgl_eval(args)
+        print(f"Evaluation metrics: {metrics}")
+        self.assertGreater(metrics["score"], 0.62)
+
+    def test_greedy_matches_sequential(self):
+        """Concurrent greedy outputs match the same prompts run one at a time."""
+        prompts = [
+            f"Shared instructions: answer briefly and precisely. Question {i}: "
+            f"what is {i} times {i + 3}?"
+            for i in range(32)
+        ]
+
+        def generate(prompt):
+            res = requests.post(
+                self.lb_url + "/generate",
+                json={
+                    "text": prompt,
+                    "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0, "max_new_tokens": 1},
+                },
+            )
+            res.raise_for_status()
+            return res.json()["text"]
+
+        sequential = [generate(p) for p in prompts]
+        with ThreadPoolExecutor(16) as pool:
+            concurrent = list(pool.map(generate, prompts))
+        # A single output token is produced by prefill alone, so it does not
+        # depend on decode batching; it checks the first token handed to decode.
+        self.assertEqual(sequential, concurrent)
+
+    def test_fallback_requests_concurrent(self):
+        """Logprob and grammar requests take the scheduler path alongside plain ones."""
+        regex = r"Answer: [0-9]{3}-[a-z]{4}\."
+
+        def generate(i):
+            body = {
+                "text": f"Request {i}: give a short reply.",
+                "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0, "max_new_tokens": 16},
+            }
+            if i % 3 == 1:
+                body["return_logprob"] = True
+            elif i % 3 == 2:
+                body["sampling_params"]["regex"] = regex
+            res = requests.post(self.lb_url + "/generate", json=body)
+            res.raise_for_status()
+            return i, res.json()
+
+        with ThreadPoolExecutor(24) as pool:
+            results = list(pool.map(generate, range(48)))
+
+        for i, out in results:
+            self.assertTrue(out["text"], f"empty output for request {i}")
+            meta = out["meta_info"]
+            if i % 3 == 1:
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    len(meta["output_token_logprobs"]), meta["completion_tokens"]
+                )
+            elif i % 3 == 2:
+                self.assertIsNotNone(re.fullmatch(regex, out["text"]), out["text"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+
+import threading

+import weakref

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, call, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.prefill_early_send import (
+    EarlyKVChunkSender,
+    _BatchSend,
+    _ChunkSend,
+)
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import KVSendOwner, TransferBackend

+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import FINISH_ABORT
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+INPUT_LEN = 100
+
+
+class _Event:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.synchronized = False
+
+    def synchronize(self):
+        self.synchronized = True
+
+
+class _Req(SimpleNamespace):
+    # Hashable by identity, like Req, so it can sit in the failed WeakSet.
+    __hash__ = object.__hash__
+    __eq__ = object.__eq__
+
+
+def _req(**overrides):
+    req = _Req(
+        rid="r",
+        bootstrap_room=1,
+        kv_send_owner=KVSendOwner.NONE,
+        origin_input_ids=list(range(INPUT_LEN)),
+        extend_end=INPUT_LEN,
+        output_ids=array("q"),
+        return_logprob=False,
+        return_sampling_mask=False,
+        grammar=None,
+        pending_bootstrap=False,
+        to_finish=None,
+        finished_reason=None,
+        kv=SimpleNamespace(holds_kv=True),
+        disagg_kv_sender=Mock(),
+        time_stats=Mock(),
+    )
+    for k, v in overrides.items():
+        setattr(req, k, v)
+    return req
+
+
+def _sender(send_kv_chunk=None):
+    """Build a sender without its CUDA worker thread."""
+    sender = EarlyKVChunkSender.__new__(EarlyKVChunkSender)
+    sender._scheduler = SimpleNamespace(send_kv_chunk=send_kv_chunk or Mock())
+    sender.lock = threading.Lock()
+    sender._queue = Mock()
+    sender._failed_reqs = weakref.WeakSet()
+    return sender
+
+
+def _scheduler(**overrides):
+    scheduler = SimpleNamespace(
+        enable_overlap=True,
+        enable_staging=False,
+        kv_checksum_computer=None,
+        spec_algorithm=SimpleNamespace(is_none=lambda: True),
+        transfer_backend=TransferBackend.MOONCAKE,
+        enable_unified_memory=False,
+        disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue=SimpleNamespace(
+            kv_manager=SimpleNamespace(kv_args=SimpleNamespace(state_types=[]))
+        ),
+    )
+    for k, v in overrides.items():
+        setattr(scheduler, k, v)
+    return scheduler
+
+
+def _result(token_ids, copy_done=True):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        copy_done=_Event() if copy_done else None,
+        next_token_ids=torch.tensor(token_ids),
+    )
+
+
+def _batch_send(token_ids, *chunks):
+    return _BatchSend(_Event(), torch.tensor(token_ids), list(chunks))
+
+
+def _patch_disagg(policy="default"):
+    return patch(
+        "sglang.srt.disaggregation.prefill_early_send.get_disagg",
+        return_value=SimpleNamespace(disaggregation_decode_allocation_policy=policy),
+    )
+
+
+class TestIsSupported(CustomTestCase):
+    def _supported(self, policy="default", **overrides):
+        with _patch_disagg(policy), patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True):
+            return EarlyKVChunkSender.is_supported(_scheduler(**overrides))
+
+    def test_supported(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._supported())
+
+    def test_unsupported_configs(self):
+        self.assertFalse(self._supported(enable_overlap=False))
+        self.assertFalse(self._supported(enable_staging=True))
+        self.assertFalse(self._supported(kv_checksum_computer=object()))
+        self.assertFalse(
+            self._supported(spec_algorithm=SimpleNamespace(is_none=lambda: False))
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(self._supported(policy="prefill_complete"))
+        self.assertFalse(self._supported(transfer_backend=TransferBackend.NIXL))
+        self.assertFalse(self._supported(enable_unified_memory=True))
+        self.assertFalse(
+            self._supported(
+                disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue=SimpleNamespace(
+                    kv_manager=SimpleNamespace(
+                        kv_args=SimpleNamespace(state_types=["mamba"])
+                    )
+                )
+            )
+        )
+
+
+class TestMaybeCreate(CustomTestCase):

+        with envs.SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_KV.override(False):
+            self.assertIsNone(EarlyKVChunkSender.maybe_create(_scheduler()))
+
+    def test_unsupported_config_warns(self):
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_KV.override(True),
+            _patch_disagg(),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            self.assertLogs(
+                "sglang.srt.disaggregation.prefill_early_send", level="WARNING"
+            ),
+        ):
+            self.assertIsNone(
+                EarlyKVChunkSender.maybe_create(_scheduler(enable_overlap=False))
+            )
+
+
+class TestOwnership(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_owner_fixed_at_first_submit(self):
+        sender = _sender()
+        plain, logprob = _req(), _req(return_logprob=True)
+        pending = _req(pending_bootstrap=True)
+        sender.submit(
+            SimpleNamespace(reqs=[plain, logprob, pending]), _result([1, 2, 3])
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(plain.kv_send_owner, KVSendOwner.EARLY)
+        self.assertEqual(logprob.kv_send_owner, KVSendOwner.SCHEDULER)
+        self.assertEqual(pending.kv_send_owner, KVSendOwner.SCHEDULER)
+
+        # Later eligibility changes do not move the owner.
+        pending.pending_bootstrap = False
+        sender.submit(SimpleNamespace(reqs=[pending]), _result([4]))
+        self.assertEqual(pending.kv_send_owner, KVSendOwner.SCHEDULER)
+
+    def test_no_result_copy_means_scheduler(self):
+        sender = _sender()
+        req = _req()
+        sender.submit(SimpleNamespace(reqs=[req]), _result([1], copy_done=False))
+        self.assertEqual(req.kv_send_owner, KVSendOwner.SCHEDULER)
+        sender._queue.put.assert_not_called()
+
+
+class TestSubmit(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_queues_middle_and_last_chunks(self):
+        sender = _sender()
+        middle, last, logprob = _req(extend_end=64), _req(), _req(return_logprob=True)
+        result = _result([3, 4, 5])
+        sender.submit(SimpleNamespace(reqs=[logprob, middle, last]), result)
+        (item,), _ = sender._queue.put.call_args
+        self.assertIs(item.copy_done, result.copy_done)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            item.chunks,
+            [
+                _ChunkSend(batch_index=1, req=middle, end_idx=64, is_last=False),
+                _ChunkSend(batch_index=2, req=last, end_idx=INPUT_LEN, is_last=True),
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def test_snapshots_end_idx(self):
+        sender = _sender()
+        req = _req(extend_end=64)
+        sender.submit(SimpleNamespace(reqs=[req]), _result([3]))
+        req.extend_end = INPUT_LEN  # next chunk scheduled
+        (item,), _ = sender._queue.put.call_args
+        self.assertEqual(item.chunks[0].end_idx, 64)
+        self.assertFalse(item.chunks[0].is_last)
+
+
+class TestSend(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_chunks_sent_in_order(self):
+        sender = _sender()
+        req = _req(kv_send_owner=KVSendOwner.EARLY)
+        first = _batch_send([0], _ChunkSend(0, req, 48, is_last=False))

+    def test_skips_aborted_and_released(self):
